C9000141.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 141 (Existential–universal real sentences in the counting hierarchy.; papers: Existential–universal real sentences in the counting hierarchy; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_DET_CORE.statement: Verify the complete indexed characteristic-coefficient contract and its specialization-safe multiplication-determinant use, or certify a hypothesis-valid counterexample; this is a shared dependency, not the main complexity theorem.

C_BASIS.statement: For every commutative coefficient ring, the pure-power quotient has the stated monomial basis and the Laurent functional descends and has the stated finite truncation.

C_TRACE.statement: The actual Laurent functional satisfies tr(M_v)=L(vJ) over arbitrary commutative rings, without reducedness, and commutes with change of coefficient ring.

C_GRID.statement: The multiplicative-grid extraction is exact at all retained trace targets and all requested exponential coefficient indices under the manuscript prime bound.

C_RECONSTRUCT.statement: For arbitrary dimension and prime p>D, the truncated exponential of actual traces agrees with det(I-zM) through degree D, including nonsemisimple matrices.

C_UNIFORM.statement: All indices, sums, products, arithmetic and oracle queries have polynomial bit length and fixed hierarchy depth uniformly in n, ell, Omega, p, k and d.

C_CHAR_COEFF.statement: Proposition prop:char-coeff holds with exactly its stated prime range and F_(a+8) bound, for all coefficient indices and nonreduced specializations.

C_MULT_DET.statement: Proposition prop:multiplication-determinant has valid prespecialization degree/norm bounds and a family-only prime cutoff and commutes with every parameter specialization.

C_MAIN.statement: Theorem thm:main: the existential-universal real-sentence language belongs to an absolute fixed level of the counting hierarchy.

C_ROOT_LABELS.statement: Every chosen real root, including multiple roots, admits the bounded short labels required by the controlled-family procedure; outside this mission.

C_CONTROLLED_EXISTS.statement: The controlled existential feasibility procedure is valid; outside this mission.

C_TWO_BLOCK_WITNESS.statement: Degree stratification, the closed lift and penalized minimization produce coordinates of an actual good parameter whenever one exists; outside this mission.

C_UNIVERSAL_BRIDGE.statement: For every finite free commutative S-algebra with basis b, S-linear L, algebra-generating g and coefficients w satisfying sum_i L(w_i)b_i=1 and g_j w_i=sum_k repr(g_j b_k)_i w_k, every multiplication power trace is L(v^k sum_i b_i w_i). For every finite square matrix over a field with 1,...,D nonzero, its truncated trace exponential equals det(I-zA) through degree D. Combining these gives every characteristic coefficient from these actual residue values, including all fields of characteristic p>D, without spectral hypotheses.

C_RESIDUE_MATCH.statement: For the actual pure-power quotient and Laurent functional over every commutative ring, the polynomial divided-difference Bezoutian obeys the generation, normalization and diagonal-annihilation hypotheses of C_UNIVERSAL_BRIDGE, and its diagonal element equals the actual Jacobian J.

C_SIZE_SPECIALIZATION.statement: Before specialization the multiplication characteristic polynomial has the manuscript degree and log-norm bounds D*(1+d*(1+T)) and D^2+D*(1+b*(1+T)); quotient reduction, residue, multiplication matrices and characteristic polynomials commute with every coefficient-ring specialization.

C_SHARP_CHAR.statement: Under exactly the full hypotheses and prime range of prop:char-coeff, every indexed characteristic coefficient is uniformly in F_max(a+2,5), by flattening the inner (k,j,u) and outer (z,h) modular sums; no squarefreeness or stronger cutoff is required.

C_FIRST_DERIVATIVE.statement: For input evaluators in F_a and degree bound d, first partial derivatives have F_(a+1) evaluators above max(input cutoff,d+1) using one flattened interpolation-derivative sum, including at zero evaluation coordinates.

C_SHARP_DET.statement: Controlled pure-power multiplication characteristic polynomials with common input evaluators in F_a have F_max(a+3,5) evaluators and the original size bounds, with primary-family-only cutoffs, uniformly at all parameter and y evaluation points.

C_PUBLISHABLE_BREAKTHROUGH.statement: An independent Reviewer certifies a genuinely new publishable breakthrough at the operator's novelty and significance boundary; a local verification or known-result reconstruction alone does not discharge campaign completion.
